name: Erdos700.FourPrime.Arithmetic.change_base
statement:
theorem change_base (q d u v h : ℤ) :
    (q-d) * (u*(q-d)^2 + v*(q-d) + (h*q-u*d^2+v*d)) =
    q * (u*q^2 + (v-3*u*d+h)*q + (2*u*d^2-d*v-d*h))

name: Erdos700.FourPrime.Arithmetic.expansion_a
statement:
theorem expansion_a (x a b c : ℤ) :
    (x-a)*(x+b-a)*(x+c-a) =
    x^3 + (b+c-3*a)*x^2 + (b*c-2*a*(b+c)+3*a^2-1)*x +
      (x-a*(b-a)*(c-a))

name: Erdos700.FourPrime.Arithmetic.expansion_b
statement:
theorem expansion_b (x a b c : ℤ) :
    (x-b)*(x+a-b)*(x+c-b) =
    x^3 + (a+c-3*b-1)*x^2 + (x-((2*b-a)*c+2*a*b-3*b^2))*x +
      b*(b-a)*(c-b)

name: Erdos700.FourPrime.Arithmetic.expansion_c
statement:
theorem expansion_c (x a b c : ℤ) :
    (x-c)*(x+a-c)*(x+b-c) =

      (x-c*(c-a)*(c-b))

theorem two_digits_normalize {q u M K : ℤ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hKlo : -q ≤ K) (hKhi : K < q)
    (hMlo : -q ≤ M + lowCarry K) (hMhi : M + lowCarry K < q) :
    (u * q ^ 2 + M * q + K) % q = normalizeDigit q K ∧
      ((u * q ^ 2 + M * q + K) / q) % q =
        normalizeDigit q (M + lowCarry K)

name: Erdos700.PairBC.zero_H_positive_u

theorem zero_H_positive_u {q d u t U : ℤ}

name: Erdos700.FourPrime.ParameterDigits.digit_bounds_a
statement:
theorem digit_bounds_a (a b c p : ℤ)
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 3 * a ≤ b) (hc : 3 * b - a + 1 ≤ c)
    (hp : 12 * c ^ 3 ≤ p) :
    0 ≤ p + a - a * (b - a) * (c - a) ∧
      p + a - a * (b - a) * (c - a) < p + a ∧
      0 ≤ b * c - 2 * a * (b + c) + 3 * a ^ 2 - 1 ∧
      b * c - 2 * a * (b + c) + 3 * a ^ 2 - 1 < p + a ∧
      0 ≤ b + c - 3 * a ∧ b + c - 3 * a < p + a

name: Erdos700.FourPrime.ParameterDigits.digit_bounds_c
statement:
theorem digit_bounds_c (a b c p : ℤ)
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 3 * a ≤ b) (hc : 3 * b - a + 1 ≤ c)
    (hp : 12 * c ^ 3 ≤ p) :
    0 ≤ p + c - c * (c - a) * (c - b) ∧
      p + c - c * (c - a) * (c - b) < p + c ∧
      0 ≤ 3 * c ^ 2 - 2 * c * (a + b) + a * b - 1 ∧
      3 * c ^ 2 - 2 * c * (a + b) + a * b - 1 < p + c ∧
      0 ≤ p + c - (3 * c - a - b) ∧ p + c - (3 * c - a - b) < p + c

    (a b c d q : ℤ)

    (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hdc : d ≤ c) (hq : 12 * c ^ 3 ≤ q) :
